Free preview of "Yuna in the Rain", a webtoon from the adult visual novel The Velvet Orchid by Waivoria Studio. 37 pages, 3 animated.
5 pages and 4 animations are locked. The full version (41 pages, 7 animations with sound) is available for paid members: patreon.com/cw/WAIVORIAStudio
All characters are fictional adults. AI-generated.
